Classification: High Clan

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} are warriors with a cause, their cold Antediluvian founder Troile having been supplanted after his own childe committed the clan's first diablerie in a rage over Troile's cruel experiments. That new Antediluvian remade the clan in a passionate image, one dedicated to bettering the world through a cause, culminating in the founding of Carthage as a city where vampires and mortals lived openly together. Carthage's fall (after the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.522046f606404b2b]{Baali} were welcomed within its walls and Rome razed it) still haunts the clan, spurring some @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} to prove such achievements are possible again while shaming others for the failure. Elders favor debate and patient observation; the young demand action and force of arms now, and this generational rift is steadily splintering the clan.

Disciplines: Celerity, Potence, Presence

Advantage: All Brujah gain one free level of Political, University or Street Influence, and an associated Ability of Politics, Academics or Streetwise.

Disadvantage: Brujah are easily prone to violence and frenzy. All Brujah suffer a one-Trait penalty on Virtue Tests of Self-Control/Instinct.

Organization: The Brujah are not unified under any central authority; elders and youth clash openly over method and goal, sometimes violently. Some despairing youths throw themselves into endless combat, treating the latest battle as their only remaining passion.

Suggested Viae: Kings, Heaven, Humanity.
